title: Magnet Scene 5 stays frozen: clip on a MASK layer loses its instanceName + onClipEvent (HasClipDepth PlaceObject2 omits Name/ClipActions) — ballmask load never fires, _root.ballmask undefined
description:
SWF COMPILER DEFECT (NOT import, NOT _parent). Magnet.fla Scene 5 "frames don't play" / the level-select menu can never be exited, because a NAMED, SCRIPTED MovieClip placed on a MASK layer is emitted as a HasClipDepth PlaceObject2 that DROPS its instance name AND its onClipEvent clipActions. The ballmask MC (Symbol 27 / symbol-65, instanceName="ballmask", carrying onClipEvent(load){ tgt=-1; gotoAndPlay("mid") }) sits on Scene 5's mask layer ("Layer 5", type=4). At publish it loses both its name and its load handler.

=== RUNTIME EVIDENCE (bundled Ruffle 0.2.0, traceObserver; instrumented publish of fixtures/Magnet.fla; probes injected into a CLONED doc, no product code touched) ===
Jump root to Scene 5 first frame (frame 3) and to "menu" (frame 4):
  [ROOT] start
  [S5 L=Layer 5 f0] enter; cf=3            (masked Layer 5 script Stage.showMenu=false runs)
  [S27 f0 label=''] reached; cf=1 tgt=undefined _parent=_level0 _parent._currentframe=3
  [S5 L=Ball f1] enter; cf=4 _root.ballmask=undefined typeof=undefined
KEY OBSERVATIONS:
 (1) Scene 5 IS reached and the masked Layer-5 + Ball-layer (menu=frame 4, stop()) scripts run. Scene 5 stops at "menu" by design (it is the level-select MENU).
 (2) The ballmask MovieClip IS instantiated (Symbol 27 frame 0 reached, runs its authored stop(), cf stays 1).
 (3) ballmask onClipEvent(load) NEVER FIRES — no load trace; tgt reads `undefined` inside the MC (the load handler that sets tgt=-1 and gotoAndPlay("mid") was stripped). So Symbol 27 never advances to "mid" and the black-circle fade-in transition never plays.
 (4) _parent resolves CORRECTLY to _level0 (the Scene-5 main timeline / root that holds the stop()). The user's "_parent mis-resolved / 1341 nesting corrupts _parent" hypothesis is DISPROVEN — _parent is the root, as intended.
 (5) _root.ballmask === undefined at the menu stop (instance NAME stripped). Therefore every level-select button's `_root.ballmask.play()` + `_root.ballmask.tgt = "AA2"...` operate on undefined → the SCENE-TRANSITION mechanism is dead → the user can never leave Scene 5 = "Scene 5 frames don't play".

NOTE on the intended design (corrects the user's premise): on a FRESH load tgt=-1, and the "mid" script (Symbol 27 frame idx 9, label "mid") gates `_parent.play()` behind `if (tgt != -1)`, so _parent.play() is DELIBERATELY skipped on first entry. _parent.play()/_parent.gotoAndPlay(tgt) is the BUTTON-driven scene-transition path (buttons set _root.ballmask.tgt then call _root.ballmask.play(), which replays the mask anim to "mid" and then navigates the root). So the real break is not "_parent.play() doesn't fire on load"; it is "ballmask is nameless + load-handler-less, so neither its fade-in nor any button-driven transition works".

=== STRUCTURE CONFIRMED (tryLoadRealFla(fixtures/Magnet.fla)) ===
Scene 5 (doc.scenes[1]) layers (top-to-bottom): li0 'Layer 5' type=mask [ballmask = symbol-65, onClipEvent(load){tgt=-1; gotoAndPlay("mid")}]; li1 'Layer 5' type=masked [symbol-81 + script Stage.showMenu=false]; li2 'Ball' type=normal [frame0 empty, frame1 label='menu' script 'stop()' + content]; li3 'Layer 3' type=normal.
Symbol 27 (symbol-65, movieclip, 1 layer): f0 stop(); f9 label='mid' script: if (tgt != -1) { if (tgt==0) _parent.play(); else _parent.gotoAndPlay(tgt); ...; tgt=0; } play(); — f10 play(); f18 tgt=0. Motion-scale tweens of symbol-67 (the fade circle).

=== ROOT CAUSE (file:line) ===
packages/swf/src/compiler/frames.ts:859-875 — the mask-layer SYMBOL-INSTANCE emit path: when `clipDepth !== undefined` it calls encodePlaceObject2WithClipDepth(charId, depth, x, y, clipDepth, instanceTransform) then `continue`s, BYPASSING the normal placement path that would emit (a) the instance name via encodePlaceObject2WithName and (b) the clipActions (the effectiveClipActions block + HasClipActions). So name + onClipEvent are silently dropped for any clip used as a mask.
packages/swf/src/shapes.ts:1375-1433 — encodePlaceObject2WithClipDepth writes flags 0x46 = HasCharacter|HasMatrix|HasClipDepth ONLY (no HasName 0x20, no HasClipActions 0x80; the code comment at :1429 even states "no CXFORM or Name present"). It has no name/clipActions parameters.
Same defect in the SHAPE mask path (frames.ts:502-511) and the SYMBOL-INTERNAL (sprite) mask paths (packages/swf/src/sprite.ts:747-748 and :917-918) — a named/scripted clip used as a mask INSIDE a symbol would lose name+clipActions too.

=== WHY SCENE 5 + AA BREAK BUT BA/AB/BB "WORK" (the 1341 connection) ===
clipDepth is only computed (frames.ts:345-370 pass-2 / sprite.ts:567-602) for a mask layer that has a CONSECUTIVE run of 'masked' layers immediately following it. The ballmask layer imports as type=mask in ALL scenes. But the masked-child run differs per scene because of the 1341 import defect (resolveMaskedLayers only promotes children AFTER the mask in bottom-to-top binary order; parentLayerRef is an unreliable 2-byte peek). Confirmed in the published SWF: Scene 5 (main frame 3) and AA (frame 5) emit a clip_depth-bearing mask placement with name=None & hasClipActions=False; BA/AB/BB ballmask (frames 58/112/167) emit NAMED PlaceObject2 WITH clipActions and clip_depth=None (no masked run qualified → fell through to the normal path, which happens to preserve name+clipActions). So the SAME compiler bug is masked in BA/AB/BB purely because 1341 left them without a qualifying masked run. This couples the two defects: 1341 (import) governs WHICH scenes hit the clipDepth path, and THIS bug (compiler) is what actually breaks them.

=== FIX DIRECTION (described, NOT applied) ===
- Extend encodePlaceObject2WithClipDepth (shapes.ts:1375) to optionally also carry HasName (0x20) and HasClipActions (0x80) — i.e. emit name + clipActions in the SAME PlaceObject2 as the clip depth (SWF allows all four flags together; field order: Depth, CharId, Matrix, [ColorTransform], [Ratio], [Name], [ClipDepth], [ClipActions]; ClipDepth precedes ClipActions). OR keep the encoder minimal and follow the mask PlaceObject2 with a PlaceObject2 Move on the same depth that adds the name + clipActions (mirrors the existing pattern at frames.ts:967 encodePlaceObject2MoveWithClipActions, but that path needs to also set the name).
- Apply at all 4 sites: frames.ts:864 (symbol mask — the Magnet case, highest priority), frames.ts:504 (shape mask — shapes have no clipActions/name normally but a named DrawingObject could), sprite.ts:748 and sprite.ts:918 (symbol-internal masks).
- The effectiveClipActions computation (loopMode synthesis, frames.ts:901-925) currently sits AFTER the clipDepth `continue`, so a graphic-mask loopMode would also be dropped; restructure so clipDepth and clipActions/name are not mutually exclusive.
- This depends on / is unblocked-by 1341: even after this compiler fix, Scene 5's masked-child set must be correct for the mask to clip the right layers; but the NAME+clipActions fix is independent and is the direct cause of the frozen menu. Recommend fixing BOTH; this one restores ballmask's name + load handler so the menu/transition logic runs.
- Acceptance (Ruffle, byte tests insufficient per Verification learning): publish Magnet.fla (or a faithful Scene-5 repro: a named MovieClip with onClipEvent(load){trace("loaded")} on a mask layer that has a masked child), run in bundled Ruffle, assert (a) the load handler fires and (b) _root.<name> resolves to the clip. Add a swf-dump byte assertion that the mask PlaceObject2 carries HasName(0x20)+HasClipActions(0x80) in addition to HasClipDepth(0x40).

Repro harness used (deleted after): instrumented publish via compileDocument on a cloned tryLoadRealFla(Magnet.fla) doc with trace() probes; Playwright + bundled Ruffle traceObserver (autoplay:'on', unmuteOverlay:'hidden'). HEAD c9db373.
